articles.title: BrainsWay Announces Strategic Collaboration with Mindful Health Solutions
articles.description: Latest Collaboration Comes Amid Progress in Other Strategic Initiatives, Including Follow-on Investment in Earlier Minority Stake Investment Target BURLINGTON, Mass. and JERUSALEM, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- BrainsWay Ltd. (NASDAQ & TASE: BWAY) ("BrainsWay” or the "Company”), a global leader in advanced noninvasive neurostimulation treatments for mental health disorders, announced a strategic collaboration with Mindful Health Solutions ("MHS”), an established provider of comprehensive behavioral health and interventional psychiatry services. In August, Mindful Health Solutions’ managed services organization was acquired by Radial Health, Inc. The combined management company, operating under the Radial banner, now supports the largest network of brain medicine clinics in the US, operating 27 locations across California, Missouri, New York, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas and Washington. The strategic collaboration aims to expand patient access to innovative, noninvasive mental health treatments including BrainsWay Deep TMS™ and the recently FDA-cleared accelerated SWIFT™ treatment protocol, as well as to explore opportunities to integrate Neurolief’s Proliv™Rx at-home neuromodulation therapy into broader patient care pathways. In addition, the companies intend to build and facilitate physician education and clinical awareness through joint initiatives, including key opinion leader (KOL) programs, educational events, targeted outreach to healthcare professionals, and research into synergistic treatment approaches. The collaboration reflects a shared commitment to improving clinical outcomes and developing scalable models of care across both clinical and at-home settings. "We are elated to collaborate with Mindful Health Solutions, an organization that shares our commitment to advancing interventional psychiatry and improving patient outcomes,” said Hadar Levy, Chief Executive Officer of BrainsWay. "We are proud to deepen our relationship with one of the country’s leaders in brain medicine research and real-world clinical operations. By combining our innovative technology and expanding neuromodulation portfolio with MHS’s clinical expertise, we see meaningful opportunities to accelerate the adoption of powerful existing therapies we currently offer as well as to potentially identify new treatment approaches.” The collaboration comes after additional progress in BrainsWay’s broader strategic initiatives, including its recent follow-on equity investment of $0.8m in the management services organization servicing the Texas-based "Heading Health” clinic network. These efforts reflect BrainsWay’s broader strategy of partnering with leading behavioral health providers to increase awareness and accelerate the growth of interventional psychiatry. About BrainsWay BrainsWay is a global leader in advanced noninvasive neurostimulation treatments for mental health disorders. The Company is advancing neuroscience with its proprietary Deep Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (Deep TMS™) platform technology to improve health and transform lives. BrainsWay is the first and only TMS company to obtain three FDA-cleared indications backed by pivotal clinical studies demonstrating clinically proven efficacy. Current indications include major depressive disorder (including reduction of anxiety symptoms, commonly referred to as anxious depression), obsessive-compulsive disorder, and smoking addiction. The Company is dedicated to leading through superior science and building on its unparalleled body of clinical evidence. Additional clinical trials of Deep TMS in various psychiatric, neurological, and addiction disorders are underway. Founded in 2003, with operations in the United States and Israel, BrainsWay is committed to increasing global awareness of and broad access to Deep TMS. For the latest news and information about BrainsWay, please visit www.brainsway.com. articles.title: Dynacor Feeds First Ore to Ecuador Mill
articles.description: MONTREAL, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Dynacor Group Inc. (TSX: DNG) ("Dynacor” or the "Corporation”) is pleased to update on its Svetlana plant in Ecuador as it advances towards production restart. Svetlana was over 80% complete as at September 30, and on budget. Dynacor has been informed of extended delivery timelines for the Svetlana cyclone cluster and additional refurbishment requirements for the elution and refinery circuit. As a result, Dynacor expects a short delay in the hot commissioning and ramp-up of the Svetlana plant. All other critical areas of the plant rehabilitation and restart are progressing to plan including: First ore crushed - First ore was fed through the crushing circuit at end of October. Crushing plant is being commissioned on sterile rock before transitioning to low-grade ore. Commissioning is underway - Dry commissioning is ongoing in the crushing, grinding and leaching circuits and will commence in the other circuits over the coming weeks. Hot commissioning is scheduled for December, followed by plant ramp-up in Q1 2027. First gold pour is expected in January. Plant rehabilitation is 82%complete and on budget. Refurbishment of the main equipment in the crushing, grinding and leaching areas is complete. On budget - As of September 30, 2026, approximately US$10.7 million had been spent (and US$4 million committed) of the US$22-$25 million projected capital expenditure for 2026. Tailings - The working tailings storage facility is now operational. Growing supplier pool- To accelerate the plant ramp-up, Dynacor plans to source ore from permitted artisanal and small-scale miners (ASMs) through the following: Svetlana purchasing department - The internal purchasing team is in discussions with individual ASM suppliers close to Portovelo, a hub for ore processing in the region. Partnership with planetGold - Under the recently signed collaboration agreement, planetGold will select and refer ASMs enlisted in its Ecuador program to Svetlana who, in turn, will evaluate them and their ore for formalised, mercury-free processing. Initially, this will give Svetlana access to 25-50 ASM suppliers. Led by the United Nations Environment Programme, planetGOLD works globally to make ASM practices safer, cleaner and more profitable. Additional initiatives are underway to increase access to formalised ASM groups. Regulatory - Dynacor’s commercialisation permit is expected to be issued by Ecuador’s MAE (Ministry of Environment and Energy) in the first week of November 2026. The Corporation continues to advance its application for an Investment Protection Agreement (IPA), most recently through in-person negotiations with the Ministry of Production, Foreign Trade, Investments, and Fisheries. Phased restart - Svetlana operations are initially being launched at 300 tonnes per day (tpd), before being ramped up to 500 tpd. Daniel Misiano, President & CEO of Dynacor, stated: "While there has been a slight delay in hot commissioning, all critical aspects of the Svetlana restart are advancing as planned, the first ore milestone has been reached, and the project remains on budget. Importantly, we are on track for a strong restart due to the supplier network that is being put in place. We look forward to building on these achievements through continuing to advance to first gold and commercial production. "Svetlana is a transformational asset for Dynacor that, when ramped up, will drive material production growth and margin expansion. Each milestone completed brings us closer to that growth.” Figure 1 - Hopper loading ore into Svetlana's crushing circuit Figure 2 - CEO Daniel Misiano, and Galo García, Ecuador’s Deputy Minister of Mines, sign the planetGOLD collaboration agreement Q3-2026 Results Dynacor expects to report third-quarter 2026 financial and operational results on and about November 12, 2026. AboutDynacor Dynacor Group is an ore processing company dedicated to producing gold sourced from artisanal miners. Since its establishment in 1996, Dynacor has pioneered a responsible mineral supply chain with stringent traceability and audit standards for the fast-growing artisanal mining industry. By focusing on formalized miners, the Canadian company offers a win-win approach for governments and miners globally. Dynacor operates the Veta Dorada plant and owns a gold exploration property in Peru. The company is expanding to West Africa and within Latin America. The premium paid by luxury jewellers for Dynacor’s PX Impact® gold goes to Fidamar Foundation, an NGO that mainly invests in health and education projects for artisanal mining communities in Peru. Visit www.dynacor.com for more information. articles.title: Cipher Digital Provides Third Quarter 2026 Business Update
articles.description: Recognized First HPC Lease Revenue Expanded Barber Lake Lease Term to 20 Years, Increasing Contracted Revenue to $9.1 Billion Received Conditional Base Load Classification for Colchis (1 GW) Began Development of Lateral Pipelines to Facilitate up to 2.5 GW of On-Site Generation for Data Center Expansion NEW YORK, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Cipher Digital Inc. (NASDAQ: CIFR) ("Cipher” or the "Company”), a leading developer, owner, and operator of industrial-scale data centers, today announced its third quarter 2026 financial results, with an update on its operations and business strategy. The third quarter marked a milestone in Cipher’s transition to a leading HPC development platform, as the Company recognized its first HPC lease revenue following rent commencement at Black Pearl. Across Black Pearl and Barber Lake, multiple data halls are scheduled to come online through year-end. Cipher also highlighted its previously announced amendment to the Barber Lake lease, which adds a second 10-year term directly with a leading AI lab. The amendment increases total contracted revenue at the site to approximately $9.1 billion, adding approximately $5.2 billion of incremental rent. It also establishes a phased delivery schedule aligned with the tenant’s compute deployment, and construction remains on track to deliver against the amended schedule. In the third quarter, the Company received conditional classifications across several pipeline sites through ERCOT’s Batch Zero process, including a conditional base load classification for 1 GW at Colchis and conditional studied load classifications with Provisional Controllable Load Resource ("PCLR”) designations for an additional 1.6 GW. The Company also commenced development of lateral natural gas pipelines capable of supporting up to 2.5 GW of on-site generation, and acquired Horizon, a 70 MW site in Texas expected to energize in 2029. The pipeline also includes 270 MW of capacity available in 2027, for which the Company continues to advance tenant discussions and design work. Cipher’s development pipeline today totals approximately 5.9 GW. "Cipher was built for this market, and this quarter we took important steps to strengthen our position for the long term,” said Tyler Page, Chief Executive Officer. "The decisions we made early on about who we partner with, how we structure our projects, how we navigate a dynamic regulatory environment and how we engage with our communities were made for exactly these conditions. Demand for compute is growing, and our relationships with leading hyperscalers and AI labs are deepening. We are adding new capacity to our pipeline, investing earlier in every project and advancing design work before committing to new leases, so we are well positioned for our next phase of growth.” Finance and Operations Highlights Recognized first HPC lease revenueDelivered first capacity at Black Pearl with additional capacity across all three campuses expected to come online in phases over the coming monthsExpanded the Barber Lake lease to a 20-year term, increasing total contracted revenue at the site to approximately $9.1 billionAcquired Horizon, a 70 MW Site in Texas with energization expected in 2029Completed an $850 million offering of 0.000% convertible senior notes due 2032, funding additional equity investment into Barber Lake in connection with the lease expansion, with associated capped call transactions raising the effective conversion price to $28.35 per shareEquitized approximately $165.9 million of the 1.750% convertible notes due 2030, retiring more than 90% of those notesReceived a conditional base load classification for 1 GW and conditional studied load classifications for 1.6 GW with PCLR designations, through ERCOT’s Batch Zero processCommenced development of lateral pipelines to support up to 2.5 GW of potential on-site generation across multiple sitesBarber Lake data center construction on track to meet the amended milestonesBlack Pearl data center continues to progress towards completion with ongoing equipment installation and energization across various data hallsStingray construction advancing, with steel erection progressing on schedule and shell construction expected to be completed in the fourth quarterQ3 2026 Revenue of $27 million and Adjusted EBITDA of negative $10 millionBusiness Update Call and Webcast The live webcast and a webcast replay of the conference call can be accessed from the investor relations section of Cipher’s website at https://investors.cipherdigital.com/. articles.title: Dynacor Feeds First Ore to Ecuador Mill
articles.description: MONTREAL, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Dynacor Group Inc. (TSX: DNG) ("Dynacor” or the "Corporation”) is pleased to update on its Svetlana plant in Ecuador as it advances towards production restart. Svetlana was over 80% complete as at September 30, and on budget. Dynacor has been informed of extended delivery timelines for the Svetlana cyclone cluster and additional refurbishment requirements for the elution and refinery circuit. As a result, Dynacor expects a short delay in the hot commissioning and ramp-up of the Svetlana plant. All other critical areas of the plant rehabilitation and restart are progressing to plan including: First ore crushed - First ore was fed through the crushing circuit at end of October. Crushing plant is being commissioned on sterile rock before transitioning to low-grade ore. Commissioning is underway - Dry commissioning is ongoing in the crushing, grinding and leaching circuits and will commence in the other circuits over the coming weeks. Hot commissioning is scheduled for December, followed by plant ramp-up in Q1 2027. First gold pour is expected in January. Plant rehabilitation is 82%complete and on budget. Refurbishment of the main equipment in the crushing, grinding and leaching areas is complete. On budget - As of September 30, 2026, approximately US$10.7 million had been spent (and US$4 million committed) of the US$22-$25 million projected capital expenditure for 2026. Tailings - The working tailings storage facility is now operational. Growing supplier pool- To accelerate the plant ramp-up, Dynacor plans to source ore from permitted artisanal and small-scale miners (ASMs) through the following: Svetlana purchasing department - The internal purchasing team is in discussions with individual ASM suppliers close to Portovelo, a hub for ore processing in the region. Partnership with planetGold - Under the recently signed collaboration agreement, planetGold will select and refer ASMs enlisted in its Ecuador program to Svetlana who, in turn, will evaluate them and their ore for formalised, mercury-free processing. Initially, this will give Svetlana access to 25-50 ASM suppliers. Led by the United Nations Environment Programme, planetGOLD works globally to make ASM practices safer, cleaner and more profitable. Additional initiatives are underway to increase access to formalised ASM groups. Regulatory - Dynacor’s commercialisation permit is expected to be issued by Ecuador’s MAE (Ministry of Environment and Energy) in the first week of November 2026. The Corporation continues to advance its application for an Investment Protection Agreement (IPA), most recently through in-person negotiations with the Ministry of Production, Foreign Trade, Investments, and Fisheries. Phased restart - Svetlana operations are initially being launched at 300 tonnes per day (tpd), before being ramped up to 500 tpd. Daniel Misiano, President & CEO of Dynacor, stated: "While there has been a slight delay in hot commissioning, all critical aspects of the Svetlana restart are advancing as planned, the first ore milestone has been reached, and the project remains on budget. Importantly, we are on track for a strong restart due to the supplier network that is being put in place. We look forward to building on these achievements through continuing to advance to first gold and commercial production. "Svetlana is a transformational asset for Dynacor that, when ramped up, will drive material production growth and margin expansion. Each milestone completed brings us closer to that growth.” Figure 1 - Hopper loading ore into Svetlana's crushing circuit Figure 2 - CEO Daniel Misiano, and Galo García, Ecuador’s Deputy Minister of Mines, sign the planetGOLD collaboration agreement Q3-2026 Results Dynacor expects to report third-quarter 2026 financial and operational results on and about November 12, 2026. AboutDynacor Dynacor Group is an ore processing company dedicated to producing gold sourced from artisanal miners. Since its establishment in 1996, Dynacor has pioneered a responsible mineral supply chain with stringent traceability and audit standards for the fast-growing artisanal mining industry. By focusing on formalized miners, the Canadian company offers a win-win approach for governments and miners globally. Dynacor operates the Veta Dorada plant and owns a gold exploration property in Peru. The company is expanding to West Africa and within Latin America. The premium paid by luxury jewellers for Dynacor’s PX Impact® gold goes to Fidamar Foundation, an NGO that mainly invests in health and education projects for artisanal mining communities in Peru. articles.title: American Lithium Increases Macusani Uranium Measured and Indicated Resource
articles.description: Project Advancing Towards Updated PEA VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- American Lithium Corp. ("American Lithium” or the "Company”) (TSX-V:LI | OTCQX:AMLIF | Frankfurt:5LA1) is pleased to announce an updated Mineral Resource Estimate ("MRE”) for the Macusani Uranium Project ("Macusani” or the "Project”), located in southeastern Peru. The updated resource estimate, with a larger share of the resource now classified as Measured and Indicated, positions Macusani as the largest known, undeveloped uranium project in South America. The updated Macusani Project MRE is as follows: Measured: 10.482 million tonnes ("Mt”) at 179 parts per million ("ppm”) U3O8 totaling 4.13 million pounds ("Mlbs”) U3O8Indicated: 111.426 Mt at 216 ppm U3O8 totaling 53.03 Mlbs U3O8Inferred: 114.873 Mt at 258 ppm U3O8 totaling 65.32 Mlbs U3O8 Macusani benefits from near surface uranium mineralization, favourable historical metallurgical results, including rapid leach times and low acid consumption, and established regional infrastructure. Combined with community support and exploration upside, these characteristics support the Project's potential to become a competitive, low-cost uranium producer. "The updated Macusani Mineral Resource Estimate represents another important step forward for the Project and reinforces our confidence in its long-term potential,” stated Alex Tsakumis, CEO. "With more than 40 undrilled uranium surface occurrences across the project area, we see significant opportunity for Macusani to grow, particularly with the dedicated focus it deserves. It remains the Company’s intention to transition Macusani into a stand-alone uranium-focused company. With the world entering what many believe to be a nuclear renaissance, we look forward to participating in this exciting period as we continue to advance Macusani,” he added. With the updated MRE complete, work on an updated Preliminary Economic Assessment ("PEA”) is well underway, incorporating current uranium pricing and development costs. The Company also plans to advance expansion and infill drilling, metallurgical piloting and ultimately a Pre Feasibility Study ("PFS”). These next steps will further evaluate Macusani's economic potential and establish a clearer pathway toward future development. The updated MRE has been established using conservative parameters for demonstrating reasonable prospects for eventual economic extraction ("RPEEE”). Current Peruvian mining costs, updated processing cost estimates combined with a long-term uranium selling price of US$100/lb U3O8 result in an open pit-constrained cut-off of approximately 47 ppm Uranium ("U”) and an underground mining block constrained cut-off of approximately 111 ppm U. The historical MRE used a global 75 ppm U cut-off, costs established in 2015 along with a US$50/lb U3O8 selling price assumption. The revised resource estimate also reflects changes to Mineral Resource reporting practices introduced in 2020, several years after the previous MRE was completed in 2015. These changes include the application of stricter pit and stope constrained resource reporting, with differences between the historical and updated resource estimates reflecting updated reporting requirements and economic constraints rather than changes to the underlying geological model. The updated MRE was completed by the Deloitte Consulting (Pty) Ltd ("Deloitte”) Qualified Person ("QP”) based in Johannesburg, South Africa, in accordance with the latest National Instrument NI 43-101 Standards of Disclosure for Mineral Projects (NI 43-101) and U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC”) property disclosure regulations (S-K 1300) requirements. Macusani Project Mineral Resource Details The previous Macusani MRE, prepared by The Mineral Corporation ("TMC”), was last included in the NI 43-101 Preliminary Economic Assessment ("PEA”) report dated March 2015. Deloitte updated the MRE effective July 01, 2026. The QP had previously contributed to the development of the MRE while employed by TMC and has conducted multiple site visits to the Macusani uranium deposits, most recently in March 2025. The MRE used a total of 1,152 diamond drillholes completed across the Project, comprising 114,576 metres ("m”) of drilling. Sampling intervals varied to preserve the integrity of higher-grade mineralized zones. All assay data were vertically composited into 1.5 m bench composites, which formed the basis of the estimation process. Geological interpretation and block modelling were undertaken using Datamine® software. Mineral Resources were estimated using Multiple Indicator Kriging ("MIK") for two mineralized domains (Zones A and B), which are oriented sub-parallel to the basal mineralization surface. Dynamic anisotropy was applied to permit the rotation of search ellipsoids and variogram models on a cell-by-cell basis, thereby reflecting the gently dipping geometry of uranium mineralization. The block models were constructed using parent cell dimensions of 50 m × 50 m × 3 m in well-informed areas and 100 m × 100 m × 3 m in less informed areas, accommodating both potential open-pit and underground mining scenarios. The selected estimation approach appropriately reflects the highly skewed uranium grade distribution and the interpreted geometry of the mineralized horizons. Tonnage estimates were derived using measured bulk density data. Mineral Resource classification was based on a combination of geostatistical parameters, including kriging efficiency, geological confidence, drillhole spacing, and quality assurance and quality control ("QAQC”) considerations. As part of the update, the QP reviewed and validated the existing models through statistical analyses, visual validation, and swath plot assessments. The QP also reassessed the classification criteria to incorporate drillhole spacing, geological continuity, estimation confidence, and practical mining considerations. The updated MRE was subsequently constrained within conceptual open-pit shells and, where applicable, evaluated for underground extraction potential. RPEEE was demonstrated using assumptions relating to long-term uranium price (US$100/lb), mining and processing costs, metallurgical recovery, pit slope parameters, and appropriate cut-off grades (~47 ppm U for open pit and ~111 ppm U for underground).
